items.q: What types of pool tables do you remove?
a: We professionally remove all types and sizes of pool tables including residential, commercial, antique, and tournament-size tables.

items.q: Do you dismantle the tables before removal?
a: Yes, our team carefully disassembles every pool table using proper techniques to protect all components including slate beds, felt, and pockets.

items.q: How is the cost of pool table removal determined?
a: Pricing depends on the table size, location complexity, and additional services needed. We provide free, transparent quotes with no hidden fees.
We offer pool table removal services throughout Whitby, Toronto, and nearby. Contact us to confirm availability for your specific location.
Yes, we often provide same-day or next-day removal depending on schedule availability.

items.q: What happens to removed pool tables?
a: We prioritize donating playable tables to community organizations and responsibly recycle all components when possible.

items.q: Can you remove tables from difficult locations?
a: Absolutely. Our teams are experienced with basement, upper floor, and tight space removals using specialized equipment.

items.q: Do I need to prepare the area beforehand?
a: No preparation is needed. We handle everything from disassembly to final cleanup of the space.
